name: orbit-radar
title: Orbit Radar
description: A radar dish rises from the edge: a beam sweeps round and a small craft climbs the rim as minutes count.

perf.budget: The beam and craft are still canvases and views turned on the UI thread, so the beam animates at rest without redrawing.

a11y.reducedMotion: The beam holds still, the craft jumps to its place and the minutes do not count.
